narrator: Van Helsing (phonograph), Jonathan Harker, Mina Harker, Dr. Seward
summary: Van Helsing records a message for Harker: the Count has fled to Transylvania by ship. The party consults Lloyd's and finds the sailing ship Czarina Catherine, which left Doolittle's Wharf for Varna. Dockhands describe the pale man in black and straw hat who loaded a large box and called fog up around the ship. Van Helsing explains the Count's persistence and why pursuit is necessary. Mina sees her own forehead scar in a mirror and knows she is still unclean. Seward and Van Helsing realise Mina is changing and may be mentally linked to the Count, so she is excluded from councils. They plan to leave for Varna by 17 October at latest, adding Winchesters. Mina makes Jonathan promise not to tell her the plans, then reveals at dawn on 6 October that she must go along because the Count will summon her. Van Helsing decides to put a wild-rose branch on the box aboard the ship. Harker makes his will; sunset approaches and Mina calls him.

scenes.title: Van Helsing's phonograph message
scenes.summary: Message left for Harker: the Count has returned toward his Castle; stay with Mina.
scenes.key_quote: He, our enemy, have gone away; he have gone back to his Castle in Transylvania.

scenes.title: Harker and Mina reread the diaries
scenes.summary: The scar on Mina's forehead prevents any disbelief.
scenes.key_quote: Whilst that lasts, there can be no disbelief.

scenes.title: Search at Lloyd's and Doolittle's Wharf
scenes.summary: Lloyd's list shows a single Black Sea ship leaving on the tide; at the wharf a bribe loosens the foreman's tongue.
scenes.key_quote: only one Black-Sea-bound ship go out with the tide. She is the Czarina Catherine

scenes.title: The Count loads his box (reported)
scenes.summary: The thin man in straw hat arranges passage, drives a cart with a great box, lifts it down himself, argues with the captain, then returns at full tide as fog covers the ship.
scenes.key_quote: A thin mist began to creep up from the river, and it grew, and grew; till soon a dense fog enveloped the ship and all around her.

scenes.title: Report meeting
scenes.summary: Van Helsing reports, explains Ristics the agent at Varna, argues the necessity of pursuit and compares the Count to a man-eater.
scenes.key_quote: This that we hunt from our village is a tiger, too, a man-eater, and he never cease to prowl.

scenes.title: Mina's mirror
scenes.summary: Feeling peace, Mina sees the red mark in the mirror and knows she is still unclean.
scenes.key_quote: I caught sight in the mirror of the red mark upon my forehead; and I knew that I was still unclean.

scenes.title: Van Helsing and Seward decide to exclude Mina
scenes.summary: They see vampire traits in Mina - sharper teeth, hard eyes, silences - and decide she must be kept out of plans.
scenes.key_quote: Madam Mina, our poor, dear Madam Mina is changing.

scenes.title: Plan of Campaign
scenes.summary: Overland journey to Varna in three days against a voyage of three weeks; leave by 17th at latest; add Winchesters.
scenes.key_quote: we must leave here on 17th at latest.

scenes.title: Mina's promise
scenes.summary: Mina makes Jonathan promise not to tell her the plans; a door shuts between them.
scenes.key_quote: I felt that from that instant a door had been shut between us.

scenes.title: Mina insists on going
scenes.summary: At sunrise, while she can speak freely, she says the Count's will compels her and she is safer with the party.
scenes.key_quote: I know that when the Count wills me I must go.

scenes.title: The wild-rose plan and wills
scenes.location: Van Helsing's room, then Harkers' room
scenes.summary: Van Helsing proposes to board the ship, place a wild-rose branch on the box and open it when unseen; Quincey will not wait. Harker makes his will.
scenes.key_quote: we shall place a branch of the wild rose on it. This we shall fasten, for when it is there none can emerge

locations.name: Lloyd's
locations.description: Shipping register where all sailings, even small ships, are recorded.
locations.quote: where are note of all ships that sail, however so small.

locations.name: Doolittle's Wharf
locations.description: Thames wharf with a very small wooden office, gang-plank, truck for cargo; rough hot dockhands.
locations.quote: a man in an office of wood so small that the man look bigger than the office.

locations.name: The Czarina Catherine
locations.description: A sailing ship bound for Varna and then up the Danube.
locations.quote: She is the Czarina Catherine, and she sail from Doolittle’s Wharf for Varna

locations.name: Seward's study
locations.description: Meeting room where reports and plans are made.
locations.quote: We are to meet here in my study in half an hour

locations.name: Harkers' room
locations.description: Bedroom with a mirror in which Mina sees her scar.
locations.atmosphere: intimate, charged at sunrise and sunset
locations.quote: She had fallen back on her pillow asleep; she did not even wake when I had pulled up the blind

locations.name: Varna (planned)
locations.description: Black Sea port, unfamiliar to all of the party, where the box will be landed to agent Ristics.
locations.quote: The box we seek is to be landed in Varna, and to be given to an agent, one Ristics

characters.name: Mina Harker
characters.appearance: sharper teeth, hard eyes at times, red scar
notable_lines: You must take me with you. I am safer with you, and you shall be safer, too.
abilities: can be hypnotised to report on the Count

characters.name: Count Dracula
characters.appearance: tall thin pale man with high nose, very white teeth, burning eyes
characters.clothing: all black except a straw hat

characters.name: Quincey Morris
notable_lines: I shall not wait for any opportunity. When I see the box I shall open it and destroy the monster

creatures.name: Fog around the ship
creatures.description: Dense local fog that rises from the river and encloses only the Czarina Catherine and the wharf.
creatures.behaviour: Called by the Count to delay departure to full tide and hide him.
creatures.quote: a dense fog enveloped the ship and all around her.

creatures.name: Wolves of the Carpathians (anticipated)
creatures.quote: the Count comes from a wolf country

vampire_lore.rule: The Count seeks to return to his castle and uses ships
vampire_lore.detail: He needs earth-box and sea passage, cannot cross water except as ship reaches land at full or slack tide.
vampire_lore.quote: for there are waters between us which he do not want to pass

vampire_lore.rule: Wild rose on the box prevents emerging
vampire_lore.detail: A fastened wild-rose branch keeps him in, per superstition.
vampire_lore.quote: when it is there none can emerge; so at least says the superstition.

vampire_lore.rule: Best time to attack is in the box between sunrise and sunset
vampire_lore.detail: In the box by day he can make no struggle.
vampire_lore.quote: Our best hope is to come on him when in the box between sunrise and sunset

vampire_lore.rule: Weather control: fog at his command
vampire_lore.detail: Could shorten the voyage by about two days.
vampire_lore.quote: our enemy is on the sea, with the fog at his command

vampire_lore.rule: Vampire's baptism of blood causes transformation and mental link
vampire_lore.detail: Mina grows sharper teeth and hard eyes, falls silent; may be compelled to disclose what she knows.
vampire_lore.quote: I can see the characteristics of the vampire coming in her face.

vampire_lore.rule: The Count can summon victims mentally
vampire_lore.detail: When he wills, Mina must go, even by guile.
vampire_lore.quote: I know that when the Count wills me I must go.

vampire_lore.rule: Sunrise and sunset open a window of clarity for Mina
vampire_lore.detail: She can speak freely only as the sun rises; uneasiness at sunset.
vampire_lore.quote: I can tell you now, whilst the sun is coming up; I may not be able again.

vampire_lore.rule: A sacred wafer scar remains while the vampire lives
vampire_lore.detail: The red scar stays on Mina's forehead.
vampire_lore.quote: Whilst that lasts, there can be no disbelief.

vampire_lore.rule: The Count's power derives from his homeland's occult geology
vampire_lore.detail: Caverns, fissures, volcanic springs and gases, magnetic or electric forces.
vampire_lore.quote: There are deep caverns and fissures that reach none know whither.

vampire_lore.rule: He cannot pass running water except at tide
vampire_lore.detail: Safe to rest while he is on the sea.
vampire_lore.quote: he be not in the same land with us.

puzzles.name: Find the ship
puzzles.setup: Count believed to have left London by ship at night.
puzzles.obstacle: Dozens of vessels leave the Port of London.
puzzles.book_solution: Deduce Black Sea route, sailing ship, check Lloyd's for one ship leaving with the tide, then interview dockhands.
puzzles.game_idea: Investigation hub: filter shipping list by route, rig and tide time, then question NPCs with bribe options.
puzzles.quote: only one Black-Sea-bound ship go out with the tide.

puzzles.name: Travel schedule
puzzles.setup: Ship takes about three weeks, overland takes three days.
puzzles.obstacle: Arrive at Varna before the ship.
puzzles.book_solution: Subtract two days for supernatural weather, add one day for delays, leave by 17 October latest.
puzzles.game_idea: Logistics puzzle with route and day counter.
puzzles.quote: we must leave here on 17th at latest.

puzzles.name: Keeping Mina from the Count's mind
puzzles.setup: Mina may be compelled to speak what she knows.
puzzles.obstacle: Excluding her from planning without breaking her trust.
puzzles.book_solution: Mina herself asks to be excluded and extracts Jonathan's promise.
puzzles.game_idea: Information-control mechanic: certain NPCs must not receive plan flags.
puzzles.quote: Promise me that you will not tell me anything of the plans formed for the campaign against the Count.

puzzles.name: Sealing the box on the ship
puzzles.setup: Box in the hold of a crewed ship.
puzzles.book_solution: Board, identify box, fasten a wild rose branch, then open when none are near.
puzzles.game_idea: Stealth boarding mission with crew patrols.
puzzles.quote: We shall at the first board that ship; then, when we have identified the box, we shall place a branch of the wild rose on it.
